svg.title: The whole RAG pipeline, and where it actually breaks
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The whole RAG pipeline, and where it actually breaks” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn left-to-right RAG pipeline of ten boxes from PDFs through PARSE, CHUNK, EMBED, INDEX, RETRIEVE, RERANK, PROMPT and GENERATE to ANSWER, with a red exclamation mark and a failure mode written above every stage and the PARSE box drawn oversized, heavily outlined and highlighted. Below, the same two-column page is shown twice: once with a red snaking arrow reading straight across both columns producing interleaved nonsense that is struck through, and once with the two columns detected and read separately producing readable text. A tally records 312 two-column, 41 scanned and 89 table-heavy documents out of a thousand, and two bars compare Recall@10 of 0.72 for naive parsing against 0.83 for layout-aware parsing.
svg.text: The whole RAG pipeline, and where it actually breaks
